title: Never require disclosing one's own relationships
statement: No task may require students to disclose their own relationships.
detail: The rule was written into a drama lesson on characters' mistaken beliefs about one another, beside a caution against treating manipulation as a healthy romantic solution. It has a single source and rests on a design decision, not on a measured problem.

evidence.quote: Also avoid treating manipulation as a healthy romantic solution. No response needs a student to disclose their own relationships.
